subject: Request: Development integrity dossier for CAIQ / SIG review
messages:
From: TrustAssure Assessment <assessor@trustassure.com>
To: sofia_ivanova@redwood.com
Cc: security@finserve.com
Date: 2026-06-21T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: CAIQ / SIG - request: development integrity materials

Hi Sofia,

We are conducting the CAIQ + SIG sampling for FinServe Co. and need a focused set of artifacts demonstrating your secure software development practices for the last 12 months. To keep the scope tight, please provide the following (where possible, redacted):

- A small representative list of PRs (10–15) that show enforced code review, CI gating, and any automated checks (include PR ids, authors, reviewers, and short justification for selection).
- CI job logs for the jobs that gate production deploys for the selected PRs (redact secrets).
- Change management records for the associated releases (approval chain, timestamps, rollback notes).
- Evidence of ephemeral credential usage / short-lived keys and KMS rotation policy.
- Any runbooks or policy excerpts that describe deploy authorization flow (who can approve, emergency exceptions).

Deliverables can be links to a shared drive with redacted artifacts and a small manifest CSV listing the files. We need these by end of week to hit our assessor deadline. If there are any expected gaps, please call them out and describe compensating controls.

Thanks,
Lena Morales
Senior Assessor, TrustAssure
assessor@trustassure.com

---
Attachments: request-checklist.pdf (1 page)
From: sofia_ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>

Hi Lena,

Thanks for the clear scope — we can assemble an "integrity dossier" with the requested samples. Quick notes on approach:

- We'll provide a manifest CSV listing PR ids and the redacted artifacts for each.
- CI logs will be exported and redacted for secrets; large archives will be uploaded to a shared Drive link.
- Change management will be pulled from our deploy approvals ledger (includes approvers, timestamps, and rollback flags).
- KMS rotation policy is an internal PDF; we'll supply a redacted version and a short extract that shows rotation cadence and custodians.

Expectation and timeline:
- Preliminary manifest + 5 PR samples by EOD tomorrow.
- Full package (10–15 PRs, CI logs, deploy chronology, KMS excerpt) by Wednesday COB.

Jordan and Irene — can you confirm we have the CI exports for May and the deploy approval sheet for Q1–Q2 ready to share? If any artifacts require legal redaction, loop in compliance.

Sofia
Director, Product Security
Redwood Inference
